claims.claim: The Canon EOS 5D Mark II is a full-frame DSLR camera known for its 21.1-megapixel sensor.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies the body as Canon EOS 5D Mark II, but provides no sensor/spec confirmation (no readable spec plate or test results).
Witness photos show a Canon logo and “EOS 5D Mark II” markings on the camera body.

risks.risk: Camera may be sold as a Canon 5D Mark II but could have been misrepresented by the seller (brand confusion suggests possible broader misrepresentation).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front with the Canon logo and the exact model text, plus a close-up of the rear/side labels showing Canon/EOS 5D Mark II.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used Canon DSLR body with uncertain provenance/condition; treat as higher-risk until confirmed.

risks.risk: No lens included (witness photos show only the camera body), which materially reduces value and usability.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full package contents laid out (camera body + any lens + caps/hood).

risks.risk: Sensor condition unknown (dust, scratches, fungus) and shutter count/actuation history unknown.
risks.proof: A sensor test shot (white wall at f/16, close-up) and/or a shutter count screenshot from a camera utility; also a close-up of the sensor area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for sensor/shutter history (as not guaranteed clean and as unknown shutter wear).

risks.risk: LCD functionality unknown (no close-up test; dead pixels/lines not ruled out).
risks.proof: Video/clip showing live view on the LCD with menus and a bright/dark screen test (look for dead pixels/lines).
risks.if_unproven: Price as LCD condition unknown; assume possible defects.

risks.risk: Battery/charger not shown; battery health and whether it powers on reliably is unknown.
risks.proof: A short clip of powering on with the LCD/viewfinder display visible, plus photos of included battery and charger.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only with unknown power/operational status.

risks.risk: Controls/ports may be faulty (USB/HDMI/AV) and memory card presence unknown.
risks.proof: A clip showing playback via buttons and a connection test (e.g., HDMI output to a monitor or USB connection to a laptop).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: functionality not guaranteed beyond basic appearance.

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in the provided angles (dents, cracks, worn grips).
risks.proof: Full 360° walkaround photos (front, back, left, right, top, bottom) including grip close-ups and mount area close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially worn/used with possible cosmetic issues.

proof_requests: Confirm package contents with a laid-out photo: camera body, any lens, body cap, strap, battery, charger, cables, manuals.
Provide a sensor test image (white wall at f/16) and a close-up of the sensor area if possible.
Provide shutter count (screenshot) or a reliable method output.
Provide a short live-view clip showing LCD clarity (menus + bright/dark screen) to check dead pixels/lines.
Provide a power-on clip showing the LCD and any error messages; show battery and charger included.
Provide a ports/function test clip (USB/HDMI) and confirm memory card included or not.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item as a Canon EOS 5D Mark II DSLR body (brand/model markings visible). However, key operational and condition details are missing, so it should be priced at the worst-case for an untested/unknown-condition body-only unit until the requested proof is provided.
